briefs.explicit:
MISSION BRIEF M-006
Units: metres, seconds, kilograms. Time starts at t = 0 when every robot leaves its start location.

Locations (x, y, zone):
- base: (0, 0), outdoor
- warehouse roof: (-39, 92), roof
- office roof: (-40, 38), roof
- storage hall: (-101, -85), indoor
- pump house: (144, 144), indoor
- loading dock: (138, 3), outdoor
- fuel depot: (23, 105), outdoor
- site B: (-32, -57), outdoor

Robots:
- D1 (quadcopter): starts at base. Flies in straight lines at 8 m/s; can reach outdoor and roof locations, not indoor ones. Equipment: camera, cargo carrier (max 2 kg), thermal camera. Endurance: 960 s, including the return to its start.
- D2 (quadcopter): starts at base. Flies in straight lines at 9.5 m/s; can reach outdoor and roof locations, not indoor ones. Equipment: camera, cargo carrier (max 2 kg). Endurance: 1380 s, including the return to its start.
- M1 (mobile_manipulator): starts at base. Drives on the road grid (travel distance = |dx| + |dy|) at 1.5 m/s; can reach outdoor and indoor locations, not roofs. Equipment: cargo carrier (max 7 kg), robotic arm, camera. Endurance: 3480 s, including the return to its start.
- D3 (quadcopter): starts at base. Flies in straight lines at 7.5 m/s; can reach outdoor and roof locations, not indoor ones. Equipment: camera, cargo carrier (max 2 kg), thermal camera. Endurance: 1320 s, including the return to its start.
- M2 (mobile_manipulator): starts at base. Drives on the road grid (travel distance = |dx| + |dy|) at 1 m/s; can reach outdoor and indoor locations, not roofs. Equipment: cargo carrier (max 7 kg), robotic arm, camera. Endurance: 2940 s, including the return to its start.

Tasks:
- T1: Inspect office roof with a camera. Location: office roof. Duration: 60 s. Needs: camera.
- T2: Photograph fuel depot for the condition report. Location: fuel depot. Duration: 120 s. Needs: camera.
- T3: Deliver the sensor box (7 kg) to pump house. Location: pump house. Duration: 30 s. Needs: cargo carrier (payload 7 kg). Deadline: finished by t = 720 s.
- T4: Deliver the spare pump (7 kg) to storage hall. Location: storage hall. Duration: 60 s. Needs: cargo carrier (payload 7 kg). Deadline: finished by t = 360 s.
- T5: Replace the filter cartridge at pump house. Location: pump house. Duration: 210 s. Needs: robotic arm. Deadline: finished by t = 1020 s. Can start only after T9 is finished.
- T6: Deliver the spare pump (7 kg) to storage hall. Location: storage hall. Duration: 30 s. Needs: cargo carrier (payload 7 kg).
- T7: Tighten the valve at site B. Location: site B. Duration: 210 s. Needs: robotic arm.
- T8: Inspect warehouse roof with a camera. Location: warehouse roof. Duration: 90 s. Needs: camera. Deadline: finished by t = 180 s.
- T9: Deliver the first-aid kit (7 kg) to pump house. Location: pump house. Duration: 30 s. Needs: cargo carrier (payload 7 kg). Deadline: finished by t = 660 s.
- T10: Deliver the battery pack (7 kg) to storage hall. Location: storage hall. Duration: 60 s. Needs: cargo carrier (payload 7 kg). Deadline: finished by t = 420 s.

Rules:
1. Every task is done by exactly one robot. A robot does its tasks one at a time, in the order you list them, travelling between task locations.
2. A robot can only do a task if it has the needed equipment, enough payload capacity, and can reach the task location.
3. A task that must start after another task waits until that task is finished, even if a different robot does it.
4. Each robot must be back at its start location before its endurance runs out.
5. Keep at least 1 quadcopter on standby: it must not be given any task.
6. Every task must be finished by t = 1200 s.

Objective: minimise the finish time of the last task (the makespan).
briefs.informal:
Here's what we need from the robots today.

Positions are in metres from the base at (0, 0). Drones fly straight and can't go indoors; ground robots follow the road grid (so they travel |dx| + |dy|) and can't get onto roofs. Everyone leaves their start spot at time zero.

Places: warehouse roof (-39, 92, a rooftop); office roof (-40, 38, a rooftop); storage hall (-101, -85, indoors); pump house (144, 144, indoors); loading dock (138, 3, outside); fuel depot (23, 105, outside); site B (-32, -57, outside).

The fleet: D1, a quadcopter waiting at base, carries a camera and a thermal camera, cruises at 8 m/s, lifts up to 2 kg and has 16 minutes of flight time, return trip included. D2 is a quadcopter at base with a camera; it flies at 9.5 m/s, can lift 2 kg, and its battery lasts 23 minutes including the flight home. M1 is our mobile manipulator at base: gripper arm, camera, room for 7 kg, moves at 1.5 m/s and lasts 58 minutes including getting back. D3, a quadcopter waiting at base, carries a camera and a thermal camera, cruises at 7.5 m/s, lifts up to 2 kg and has 22 minutes of flight time, return trip included. M2 is our mobile manipulator at base: gripper arm, camera, room for 7 kg, moves at 1 m/s and lasts 49 minutes including getting back.

Jobs:
(T1) Do a visual check of office roof - that takes 1 minute on site.
(T2) We need pictures of fuel depot for the report - that takes 2 minutes on site.
(T3) Drop the sensor box off at pump house; it weighs 7 kg - that takes 0.5 minutes on site and it has to be finished within the first 12 minutes.
(T4) Storage hall needs the spare pump, which weighs 7 kg - that takes 1 minute on site and it has to be finished within the first 6 minutes.
(T5) Change the filter at pump house - that takes 3.5 minutes on site but only once the first-aid kit (T9) has arrived and it has to be finished within the first 17 minutes.
(T6) Get the spare pump (7 kg) over to storage hall - that takes 0.5 minutes on site.
(T7) The valve at site B needs tightening - that takes 3.5 minutes on site.
(T8) Have a look at warehouse roof - that takes 1.5 minutes on site and it has to be finished within the first 3 minutes.
(T9) Get the first-aid kit (7 kg) over to pump house - that takes 0.5 minutes on site and it has to be finished within the first 11 minutes.
(T10) Storage hall needs the battery pack, which weighs 7 kg - that takes 1 minute on site and it has to be finished within the first 7 minutes.

Keep one quadcopter on standby; don't give it any jobs. Everything has to be wrapped up within 20 minutes of the start, and the sooner the last job finishes, the better. Every robot has to make it back to where it started before its battery runs out.
